input.quote: Except for termination for material breach as detailed in paragraph 4(b), Kubient shall be entitled to all fees generated during the termination period regardless of which Party terminates the Agreement
input.rationale: The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, or early-termination/minimum-fee obligation payable by AP. Commercially, the deal is a pure revenue share (para. 5): Kubient contracts with Advertisers and remits AP's share within seven days of receipt, so AP owes no subscription or committed fees that could be accelerated on termination. The only termination-related money provision (para. 4(a)) entitles Kubient to fees actually generated during the 90-day notice period — that is earned revenue share on real Impressions, not a liquidated amount or penalty payable by AP, and it drops away entirely where AP terminates for Kubient's material breach. Para. 7(a) also excludes punitive and similar damages for both Parties. Search for "liquidated damages", "penalt", "minimum", "shall pay" and "damages" returned no Customer-payable liquidated sum. This meets the preferred position (no liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer); no redline required.
